latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-treasury.

- Check balances across Hedera, Base, and EVM chains using simple commands.
- Track bounty earnings and spending with a local ledger file.
- Send HBAR with an easy JavaScript snippet (requires @hashgraph/sdk).
- Check current gas prices for Base/EVM chains.
- Includes daily/heartbeat checklist for agent treasury management.
